title: Product Listings and Attributes: Filters, Sorts, Search and Layout | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Filters, sorts and search come from the fields of your product types. CrestApps lets you choose what a field is for, such as Filterable, Sortable, Searchable and shown on product cards, then set up a listing page with its filters, sorts, layout and paging, so shoppers can find the right product.

In this video:
• Why listings and attributes, and how fields, listings and visitors fit together
• Choosing what a field is for: the Product listing section
• Filling in the value on a product
• Setting up the listing page: filters, sorts, layout and paging
• What visitors see: filters, chips, sorting and Load more
• Ranges, swatches, taxonomies and the samples

chapters.title: Choose what a field is for
